title.zh: ⚡️FDUSD发行商First Digital拟以2.5亿美元估值借壳登陆纳斯达克，预计2027年上半年完成
title.en: ⚡️FDUSD发行商First Digital拟以2.5亿美元估值借壳登陆纳斯达克，预计2027年上半年完成

current_state.zh: FDUSD issuer First Digital has signed a definitive merger agreement with Nasdaq-listed CSLM Digital Asset Acquisition Corp III to go public at a $250M pre-transaction valuation, with the combined entity expected to list on Nasdaq in the first half of 2027 subject to regulatory approvals.
